result.quote: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
result.reason: The key is supported by verse 29, but the question broadly asks what the captain said, so several other details in the window are also defensible answers, including that the man was seized by the Jews, rescued by troops, and was a Roman citizen. The wording is also unnatural and underspecified; it should say “the captain” and “his letter,” and narrow the question to what he said about the accusation. The window itself also does not identify the speaker as a captain or mention Felix or a letter.
